headline: Head of Gia Binh Airport Urban Area Developer Replaced "Hot Seat"
summary: Thai Bao Infrastructure and Real Estate Development raised 480 billion dong through 7-year bonds. The report also mentions a leadership change at a developer of the Gia Binh airport urban area.
why: Vietnamese property developers rely heavily on bond markets for funding, so their debt issuance is watched as a gauge of real estate sector financing conditions.
